verdict.rationale: Dagster+ has a documented MCP server that lets an AI session 'access information and take actions' in a deployment, which plausibly covers checking run/sync status and re-triggering runs, and Dagster exposes GraphQL/REST-style APIs for automation (schedules, sensors, alerts) that agents could invoke. However, there is no explicit documentation showing the MCP server or API specifically diagnosing a failed run's root cause or a worked example of re-triggering a failed run end-to-end via MCP/API. missing for 10: explicit MCP/API examples of diagnosing failure causes (logs/error details) and re-triggering a specific failed run, independent/hands-on validation of the MCP server's action capabilities, and a documented OpenAPI/REST spec (probe found only 404s for OpenAPI endpoints).
